phases.name: Deep Forensic Audit & Empirical Oracle Verification: Sequential Visibility, MatchTiers, Spec & asEP Matrix
findings: Pillar 1 (Sequential Visibility of Locals): Empirically verified via Probes V1-V4 in angelscript_oracle.exe. Variables declared after use in 'if', loops, or functions produce ERROR: "No matching symbol 'vecOrigin'". Lambdas cannot capture outer locals (ERROR: "No matching symbol"). 'switch' cases require statement blocks {} for local declarations. Self-init 'int y = y + 1' emits WARNING: "'y' is not initialized". Before declaration, local name falls back to outer/global symbol. Root cause located in ScopeTree.cpp:48-83 (ResolveInScope has no position awareness, matching def anywhere in scope), SemanticAnalyzer.cpp:1171, and TargetResolution.cpp:353 (HoverHandler premature display). Designed visibleFromByte and ResolveInScopeAt.

Pillar 2 (Overload Resolution by MatchTiers & Pareto Dominance): Empirically verified via EntityOverriden::Find probe in angelscript_oracle.exe. All 4 distinct Find overloads resolve unambiguously when arguments match (&out h, &out idx, idx+h, idx+void). Only 'eo.Find(@ent, void)' produces ERROR: "Multiple matching signatures" due to void matching any &out parameter at Tier 1. Root cause located in ConversionRankingEngine.cpp:77-80, 159-164 (arbitrary arithmetic score collisions and treating &out as mutable ref). Designed 8 discrete MatchTiers (Exact, Qualification, Upcast, Widening, Narrowing, UserDefined, Sink, Incompatible) and strict argument-by-argument Pareto dominance.

Pillar 3 (Official Expressions & Types Spec): Empirically verified against angelscript_oracle.exe: (a) Unary minus -uint does NOT error; negates and converts to corresponding signed integer type of same width (uint8->int8, uint16->int16, uint->int, uint64->int64). (b) Bitwise operators promote 8/16-bit to 32-bit int/uint, preserve 64-bit, degrade enums to int, and >>> is native logical right shift. (c) Ternary 'cond ? a : b' is an LValue when both branches are LValues of matching type ((true ? x : y) = 10 compiles cleanly); emits 'Expression is not an l-value' if either is RValue; emits 'Can't find unambiguous implicit conversion' on incompatible types. (d) 'cast<T>' is strictly for class handles ('Illegal target type for reference cast' on primitives); 'T(x)' is for value/primitive conversions. (e) Init lists '{...}' are valid only for registered containers (array<T>), rejected on script classes. (f) Named arguments 'foo(arg: val)' are native. (g) Auto-handles '@+' are valid in function params and returns, but syntax error on local variables. (h) Logical XOR '^^' and handle identity 'is'/'!is' verified.

Pillar 4 (asEP_* Engine Properties & Grammar): Audited all 25+ language-affecting engine properties (asEP_PROPERTY_ACCESSOR_MODE, asEP_BOOL_CONVERSION_MODE, asEP_DISALLOW_GLOBAL_VARS, asEP_REQUIRE_ENUM_SCOPE, asEP_USE_CHARACTER_LITERALS, asEP_ALLOW_MULTILINE_STRINGS, asEP_DISABLE_INTEGER_DIVISION, asEP_DISALLOW_EMPTY_LIST_ELEMENTS, asEP_FOREACH_SUPPORT, asEP_EXPAND_DEF_ARRAY_TO_TMPL, asEP_ALWAYS_IMPL_DEFAULT_CONSTRUCT, etc.) across ServerConfig.h, EngineRuleConfig.h, JSON schemas, and tree-sitter-angelscript CST grammar capabilities.
